'''Lee Scott''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold 19 from Wellington, New Zealand.<ref name="sm-fan" /> The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

He collected from the game's New Zealand release.<ref name="decsq-prof" />

== In their own words ==

<blockquote>
I have collected SWCCG since the day of release in NZ.<ref name="decsq-prof" />
</blockquote>
